handback.summary: Each role now starts its agent through one interface, on the model and key the settings file names.

criteria.698.1: `dokima/agents.py` reads `.dokima/agents.yml`; the workflow points it at main's copy.
criteria.698.2: The workflow puts the secret named by `agents key ROLE` in `DOKIMA_AGENT_KEY`; the Claude adapter passes it on.
criteria.698.3: `role_settings()` in `dokima/agents.py` reads each role's subscription and model.
criteria.698.4: `dokima/agents.py` checks no model name; any name reaches the adapter.
criteria.698.5: The workflow sets `MODEL` from `agents model ROLE`, and the run starts on it.
criteria.698.6: With no file, `role_settings()` returns Claude Code, `claude-opus-5-5`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`.
criteria.698.7: A role missing from `roles` gets the same defaults in `role_settings()`.
criteria.698.8: An unknown subscription or a missing model raises `Stop`, exiting 1 before any agent.
criteria.698.9: The new settings step writes the stop message to `/tmp/why.txt`, which the not-started record posts.
criteria.698.10: `adapter()` stops when `dokima.agent_NAME` is missing or lacks the adapter functions.
criteria.698.11: The stop names the agent and reaches the issue the same way as 698.9.
criteria.698.12: The workflow's agent step runs `python3 -m dokima.agents run`, which calls the adapter's `run`.
criteria.698.13: The install step runs `agents install ROLE`; `dokima/agent_claude.py` runs today's npm install and returns its code.
criteria.698.14: `agent_claude.run` uses today's flags and order, writing its stdout to `claude.json`.
criteria.698.15: `record` and `cancelled` in `dokima/agent_roles.py` read models and stats through `agents.models` and `agents.report`.
criteria.698.17: `agent_claude.report` uses today's `run_report`, which is empty with no `claude.json`.
criteria.698.18: `agent_claude.transcript` uses today's `transcript`; the workflow passes the role and scrubs the role's key.
criteria.698.19: The adapter comes only from the subscription's `agent` line, never from the model's name.
criteria.698.20: Each role's key comes only from its own subscription line.
criteria.698.21: `agents run` exits with the agent's own code and tries nothing else.
criteria.698.22: Only the `subscriptions` and `roles` sections are read; other sections are ignored.

raises.label: Outside this issue
raises.text: The settings reader keeps an inline comment as part of a value, so a commented agent line names a wrong agent.
raises.evidence: `dokima/setup.py` `read_settings()` keeps text after `#`: `agent: claude  # x` reads as `claude  # x`.
